name: Keen Slingtether
description: Fix the gaze on the rim of a helm where a stone will bite deepest.

name: Orbitassault
description: Shorten the cord by a hand's breadth and whirl hard so the bullet leaves with a heavier punch.

name: Slung Barrage
description: Loose at the seam between breast and shoulder plates where a bullet can slip past the edge.

name: Chime Fingerhitch
description: Sweep the cord up across the chest so that a thrown spike glances off the taut line.

name: Peltbarrage
description: Squeeze a hard pulse of qi through the bullet's core so it parts mail rings instead of bruising them.

name: Hollowsling
description: Thread a small pointed bullet toward a visor slit with qi guiding it the last pace.

name: Slungcuirass
description: Strike the gorget so the neck snaps back and the foe's guard drops for a moment.

name: Nova Pelt
description: Spin a heavy slug on the cord's twist and a hard pulse of qi until it tears through one layer of plate.

name: Doctrine Cordleft
description: Loose three slugs on one rising pulse at the same plate so each opens the way for the next.

name: Cradlelinctus
description: Hold the pouch wide with two fingers so the next stone drops in without a fumble.

name: Glint Wristhitch
description: Let the empty pouch swing on straight into the next turn so the following stone is up to speed at once.

name: Chime Orbit
description: Whirl for a steady count of three and open the fingers on the third every time.

name: Vital Releasecord
description: Pull a second cord from the belt when the first frays and slip its loop on without a pause.

name: Charter Cordright
description: Raise the loaded pouch and forearm together to ward off a stone aimed at the face.

name: Charter Stonepelt
description: Loose pulse-driven stones so close together that the second leaves before the first has landed.

name: Rumbleslung
description: Reload during the last turn so the next stone is already seated as the first one flies.

name: Vitalcradle
description: Draw a little qi back into the arm between releases so the pace holds through a long volley.

name: Downpour Pouch
description: Keep the whirl running and loose a stone every turn so the volley sweeps across a packed crowd.

name: Lot Slingstone
description: Chain cast then reload then recover in one pulse so each throw lands a beat after the last.

name: Vigorous Leadshot
description: Let the qi field cling to the cord's whole length until it feels like a part of the arm.

name: Fortifying Releasecord
description: Feel the target through the field's edge before the stone has even left the hand.

name: Hoarfrost Singing
description: Open the fingers inside the field so the stone leaves already wrapped in its steering layer.

name: Murk Cradle
description: Brush an incoming stone off line with the outer layer of the field before it nears the body.

name: Gust Stonepelt
description: Nudge the flying stone with the field's edge to correct its line after it has left the pouch.

name: Grinding Flingaway
description: Snap the field taut along the cord and lash a close foe from a pace beyond arm's reach.

name: Iron Slingstone
description: Sheathe the bullet in dense field so it cuts cleanly through the face of a shield.

name: Lot Singing
description: Throw bend and call the same stone back through the field so it strikes twice from opposite sides.

name: Rumble Wristhitch
description: Let the cord out to its full length and whirl wide and slow to gather a long run of speed.

name: Restoring Cradle
description: Raise the eye line above the mark and read the distance by how the ground slopes toward it.

name: Leadshot Assault
description: Add a third turn to the whirl before the release so that the stone carries twice as far.

name: Tearing Cordleft
description: Let go at the whirl's highest point so the stone climbs steeply and glides down onto a far mark.

name: Equipoise Fingerhitch
description: Choose a bullet with a dense lead core and a smooth skin so it holds its speed far out.

name: Pouch Plating
description: Crouch behind a boulder to steady the cord's swing and cover the body before a long throw.

name: Slungtorment
description: Lift the stone on a pulse of field so that its climb is longer and its fall steeper.

name: Glint Slingtether
description: Throw across a gap between ridges with enough carry to land among the far slope's rocks.

name: Mindful Slingtether
description: Keep a faint thread of qi reaching toward the far mark to feel when the aim begins to drift.

name: Slingtorment
description: Spend a long breath winding the whirl and loose a bullet that crosses a whole valley floor.

name: Tempered Flingaway
description: Loft a slug so it falls from a height through a thatch roof or branch canopy onto a hidden target.

name: Releasecord Elixir
description: Seat two matched stones side by side in the pouch so that they will fly as a pair.

name: Severing Slung
description: Hold one cord in each hand and whirl them in opposite circles to learn the paired rhythm.

name: Gust Orbit
description: Loose the stone high into the open sky so that it falls onto a mark behind a screen.

name: Glintcradle
description: Send a stone skimming low over the flat basin floor to strike a target at the ankle.

name: Splintering Slung
description: Release two stones a breath apart so the second follows the first around a screen.

name: Pouchthrash
description: Hit one target with both stones in the same instant to double the shock of the blow.

name: Siltpouch
description: Cross the feet in a paired step that carries the thrower out of line as the second stone leaves.

name: Scorching Cordright
description: Strike a foe's front with one stone and his back with the second so the guard is caught between.

name: Doctrine Pelt
description: Run two tracks of stones from two cords on alternating beats so each pair arrives from a new angle.

name: Hoarfrost Flingaway
description: Raise the first cord in a high steady circle that serves as the upper track.

name: Slingelixir
description: Draw the second cord low and even beside the hip so it can run beneath the first.

name: Measured Wristhitch
description: Pick out a ridge line against the sky and judge both tracks' ranges from its shape.

name: Vital Leadshot
description: Pass the loop and cord from hand to hand in mid-whirl without slowing the circle.

name: Bounding Stonepelt
description: Move both feet together in short matched steps so the double whirl never throws the body off.

name: Pouchcloak
description: Spread the arms like wings to sweep two cords across the body and turn aside a thrown weapon.

name: Furrowing Cordright
description: Drive a pulse down each cord so both stones leave in the same heartbeat on different lines.

name: Hoarfrost Pelt
description: Curve the stone's path along a bend by trailing a thin field behind it like a current.

name: Daybreak Pouch
description: Hold a calm blue-clear field around both cords so neither track wavers under strain.

name: Fingerhitch Cuirass
description: Cross both cords around a rival's ankles and haul in opposite directions to pin him.

name: Dismantling Orbit
description: Whirl both cords at once and loose both pouches to scatter stones over a wide stretch of ground.

name: Intent Slung
description: Send one stone high in a hawk's dive and another low along the ground so both meet one target.

name: Exacting Cradle
description: Measure the drop from a high perch to the mark below and shape the throw to its angle.

name: Chimesling
description: Whirl from a roof edge or high ledge so the stone gains a longer fall before it lands.

name: Facet Cordleft
description: Loose the stone downward in a steep plunge that gathers speed all the way to the mark.

name: Pouchremedy
description: Curl the toes over a ledge and square the hips so the whirl never pulls the body off it.

name: Careening Singing
description: Drop from the perch and roll on landing so the fall costs nothing and the arm is free.

name: Nova Slingstone
description: Add a downward pulse of qi at the release so the plunge strikes with more than gravity gives.

name: Chimepouch
description: Pick one head out of a crowd below and hold the aim on it through every turn.

name: Rumble Pouch
description: Drop a heavy stone on a raised weapon hand so the fingers open and the blade falls.

name: Peltthrash
description: Loft the stone high and let its full fall carry it into one target's shoulders with crushing weight.

name: Pouchassault
description: Loose a bunch of small stones high so that they fall in a spread over a wide knot of foes.

name: Veritypouch
description: Take a bearing on the far mark along the plateau's edge before the first turn of the whirl.

name: Facet Slingstone
description: Keep the whirl low and tight against a strong gust so the cord is never torn from line.

name: Nova Slingtether
description: Speak the oath once under the breath and open the fingers on its last word.

name: Intent Leadshot
description: Lean the body into a cliff-edge gust so the wind holds the thrower up and not back.

name: Rumble Cordright
description: Hold the taken bearing steady while a pulse of qi carries the stone along it.

name: Trouncing Orbit
description: Aim off the mark by the measured drift so the wind itself carries the stone onto it.

name: Nova Cordleft
description: Wait for the strong gust and loose with it so the stone flies a third farther than the arm could send it.

name: Needling Flingaway
description: Hurl a heavy stone from the lip of a drop so it falls onto a climber's hands and breaks the hold.

name: Daybreak Wristhitch
description: Speak the oath under the breath while settling the stance and the whirl follows steady.

name: Novaslung
description: Raise the whirl into the open sky and let it run until the wind seems to join it.

name: Transfixing Cradle
description: Let go flat and clean with the gust at the back so the stone leaves faster than it was whirled.

name: Cradlejaunt
description: Move across bare open ground in long even steps with no wall or cover to lean on.

name: Scorching Pelt
description: Spread the field with the gust behind it and ride the stone along as it flies.

name: Waning Releasecord
description: Keep the sworn bearing unbroken in the mind while the body shifts from one stance to the next.

name: Glint Fingerhitch
description: Wrap the bullet in a thin sheath of gusting field so it drills through a leather shield.

name: Cleaving Stonepelt
description: Whirl a wide fast circle that lashes anyone who closes within the cord's sweep then loose the stone.

name: Rumble Orbit
description: Hold the sworn breath through a long winding and loose one slug that tears clean through a shield.

name: Might Cradle
description: Spread the stance wide on open ground so each thrower in the line has room to whirl.

name: Fingerhitch Elixir
description: Keep the gap to the neighbour on either side by the sound of his whirling cord.

name: Transfixing Cordleft
description: Take up the whirl in a rolling order with the line so the volleys leave in waves.

name: Rumblepelt
description: Throw along a bearing taken ahead of a charging line so stones meet it at the run.

name: Torrent Flingaway
description: Step back together with the line to restore the interval after the enemy gains ground.

name: Granite Slingtether
description: Hold the cord and forearm over the head to shield from stones lobbed down onto the line.

name: Ponderous Cordright
description: Loose pulse-driven stones in time with the whole rank so the enemy front is pinned.

name: Chime Leadshot
description: Stagger the release with the thrower on the left so the stones arrive in a rolling run.

name: Might Releasecord
description: Close a gap left by a fallen neighbour by sliding along the line without breaking the whirl.

name: Shadepouch
description: Fall back at a run while hurling stones behind so a pursuing line is pinned at every pause.

name: Doctrine Singing
description: Run the whole line through three staggered volleys so a charging front breaks apart before it closes.
